'''Knockback''' is a [[Keyword]].

== Effects ==
* Units hit with knockback will be moved back in a straight line a number of tiles equal to the amount of knockback.
* If a unit is knocked back towards the user with {{icon|Physical Damage}}, that damage is considered a backstab. <!--- Could use more testing --->

=== Knockback Damage ===
* Units that are knocked back into each other both receive Knockback Damage.
** The default damage is 1.
*** Some effects increase this, and some attacks override it with a specific higher amount.
** This damage is increased by {{st|Bruise}}, but cannot crit randomly or with {{st|Marked}}.
** The damage is indicated by the {{icon|Knockback Damage}} symbol.
* Knockback damage from being knocked into the boards edge will count as the unit dealing damage to itself.

=== Vertical Knockback ===
* Units hit with vertical knockback will get lobbed vertically into the air, making them fly over tiles.
* When a lobbed unit lands on another unit, both of them receive 5 damage.
** This damage is affected by {{st|Bonus Knockback Damage}} increases, like from {{p|Heavy Handed}}. 
* Some vertical knockback sources include: {{a|Uppercut}}, {{i|Shovel}}, {{i|Spring Board}}.
* Vertical knockback is inconsistently referred to in-game as: Lob, Knocking Units into the air, Knock Up.

=== Chain Knockback ===
Units hit by Chain Knockback will transfer all remaining knockback to another unit, if they are knocked into one.

=== {{anchor|Knockback immunity|Immunity}} ===
Certain units are immune to knockback. 

This also makes them immune to being displaced in general, making them immune to {{st|Trample}}, and unable to be moved by abilities that would Throw or Swap them.

;Sources of Knockback Immunity
* {{a|Anchor|+}}
* {{a|Form of the Tree}}
* {{p|Mountain Form}}
* {{p|Unstoppable}}
* {{i|Zaratana's Turd}}
* {{set|Brick}}
* {{mut|legs.302}}
